Key.English: Enable the Loot Nearby Zeus context menu action, which orders selected squads to sweep nearby bodies, dropped weapons, crates and unmanned vehicles and improve their loadout.
How far around a squad's leader the Loot Nearby action searches for lootable bodies, crates and vehicles (meters).

Allow looters to take first aid kits and night vision, a medikit for medics, a toolkit for engineers and a mine detector for explosive specialists. Disabled, the sweep covers weapons, armour and ammunition only.

Allow looters to swap gear they already have for something better, within the limits of their role - a rifleman upgrades to a better rifle but never picks up a machine gun, and only a unit whose role carries a launcher will take one. Disabled, looters only fill slots that are empty.
